# slice-0-conversion

The easiest golden dataset, for **conversion only** (standard → Trestle Markdown →
assembled catalog). No profiles, no baselines, no resolution, no enhancements — those
live in slices 1–3 (`slice-1-minimal/1b-resolution/` for resolution).

## Controls

- **PS-9** — Position Descriptions: no parameters, single-paragraph statement.
- **SC-25** — Thin Nodes: one parameter, single-paragraph statement.

Both are base controls with no enhancements and no lettered sub-items, so the
converter is only tested on prose, parameters and the guidance/assessment sections.
Slice-1's AU-2 (five parameters, lettered sub-items) is the natural next step up.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `catalog/` | 2-entry OSCAL catalog excerpt (JSON + YAML), verbatim prose. The expected *output* of assemble. |
| `markdown-catalog/` | Trestle-editable Markdown, one file per control. The expected *output* of AI conversion and *input* to assemble. |

Source prose: `../standards/NIST.SP.800-53r5.pdf` (PS-9, SC-25). As in slice-1, the
Markdown was generated by `trestle` from the catalog rather than by an AI converter;
see `markdown-catalog/markdown-catalog.provenance.yaml`.
